title: Bad extension
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $\{\pm1\}^n$, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction for which the restricted formula is nonconstant. Its bad extension is obtained from $\rho$ by fixing the first bad coordinate to the first bad required sign.
caveat: The referenced definitions of the first bad coordinate and first bad required sign are not supplied.
